answer: Unique answer escrow requires each new identity to submit a fresh solution to a live task. The registry hashes each answer and rejects any hash already present, so an umber-labeled copy fails. A verifier confirms the work within an oasis review window before escrow returns; duplicates forfeit it. This costs a sybil attacker one distinct, verified computation plus escrow per identity, while a reused sable answer is rejected at hash check.
